An '''iron dolabra''' is the [[Iron equipment|iron]] [[dolabra]], a combined pickaxe and axe crafted from four [[iron ingot]]s and two sticks.

=== Chest loot ===
{{Sources}}

== Usage ==

=== Mining ===
It breaks pickaxe and axe blocks at speed 6, one slower than the [[iron pickaxe]] or [[iron axe]], and has 500 durability.

Unlike the iron pickaxe, it has no obsidian restriction, so it harvests obsidian, crying obsidian and ender chests at its normal speed.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/crafting/iron_dolabra.json}}</ref> This makes it the cheapest way to collect obsidian, although the 1.12.1-alpha notes say only diamond, electrum and adamant tools can.

Matcha Flavoured adds beds, candles, cacti and honeycomb blocks to the blocks that axes break quickly.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/tags/block/mineable/axe.json}}</ref>

=== Combat ===
It deals {{Hp|6}} damage at an attack speed of 0.9.

=== Repairing ===
It can be repaired in an [[anvil]] with [[iron ingot]]s. The pack resets repair costs to zero, so it can be repaired indefinitely; see [[Repairing]].

=== Smelting and smithing ===
{{Uses}}

It melts down into an iron ingot. As an iron axe by item ID, it works as the base for the [[steel axe]] and [[steel dolabra]].
